profile.summary: Simon Brunel is a senior JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in frontend performance optimization, particularly within the Chart.js ecosystem. Their contributions demonstrate deep knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript best practices, build system tooling, and browser compatibility challenges. Simon excels at micro-optimizations (loop efficiency, bundle size reduction) and has hands-on experience with modern frontend toolchains (Gulp, Browserify, ESLint). Their work spans performance-critical rendering optimizations, CI/CD automation, and maintaining clean, maintainable codebases. The developer shows strong leadership in release engineering (tag-based CI/CD) and code quality enforcement (ESLint migrations).

Frontend Frameworks & Libraries: shared state management between chart instances
DevOps & Releases: artifact versioning (dist files in Git tags)
